description: 1. Agent reads `tools/agent-sync/logs/session_CLAW29_transcript.txt` and `tools/agent-sync/logs/peer_review_CLAW29_PR88.txt`. 2. Agent assigns self-scores for all 7 ClawRank dimensions based on the transcript evidence. Critically, Communication has NO explicit evidence in the transcript, so the agent must apply the 'No evidence = automatic 5/10' rule from SKILL.md. 3. Agent computes raw self-score (sum of 7 dims / 70) and self-final using the formula: round(raw/70*100). 4. Agent reads peer scores from the peer review file and computes peer_final = round(peer_raw/70*100) where peer_raw=47, so peer_final=67. 5. Agent computes the reported Final score as round((self_final + peer_final) / 2), NOT just the self-score. 6. Agent checks all dimensions for disagreement >2 between self and peer scores; any such dimension requires a one-line explanation in the output. 7. Agent assigns the correct crab-tier emoji and name based on the reported final score. 8. Agent formats everything into `performance_review.md` using the exact markdown table structure specified in SKILL.md, with evidence for every dimension and the Raw/Final rows. The main traps: (a) using 70 as denominator not 100, (b) averaging with peer review for the final reported score, (c) applying the no-evidence=5 rule to Communication, (d) adding disagreement explanations.
